topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, I’ll be. Turns out the kid’s got the same old bird for a teacher I used to scribble notes to in the back of class. Who'da thought it? Mrs. Hargrove, with her glasses sliding down her nose and that sharp eye for trouble. I half expected to see a younger me getting lined up for a good tongue-lashing. Funny how things circle back like this. The kid was all nerves on the first day, but I reckon they’ll be fine. After all, if I could make it through her class, anyone can. Just another twist in the city’s endless maze, I suppose.
